notes.title: The Last Tinker New Patch Version is now available!
notes.notes:
Hey there Tinkers,

yeah I know, there was a long silence on this game from our side. As you may know we were busy making Shadow Tactics and now we are full force working on our next title codenamed Kartoffel. But somehow we found a little time to do a small patch for The Last Tinker.

The main thing this patch does is fixing the problem a lot of you had with using their controllers to play the game. With this new patch it should be possible to play the game with almost every controller.

For now that´s all for The Last Tinker. But if you are interested in getting in touch with us about anything that´s on your mind, I´d really love to see you on our Discord server:

[url=https://discord.gg/uytjwD8]https://discord.gg/uytjwD8[/url]

And just in case your a super hardcore Mimi, feel free to subscribe to our exclusive mailing list:

[url=http://mail.shadow-tactics.com]mail.shadow-tactics.com[/url]

[b]PLEASE NOTE: If you experience issues on your Mac System with this new version, please try switching back to the old version which is available on the beta branch called "troubleshooting".[/b]
Instructions on how to switch to a beta branch on Steam can be found here for our other game, Shadow Tactics: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/418240/discussions/0/3377008022039876392/]http://steamcommunity.com/app/418240/discussions/0/3377008022039876392/[/url]

Cheers from Germany,
The Mimimis
